name: Jianchangopterus
isnote: Assigned by its describers to Scaphognathinae within Rhamphorhynchidae.
sum: Tiny scaphognathine from the Tiaojishan Formation of western Liaoning, China.
wsnote: At least 32 cm (measurements uncertain due to damage).
material: Complete articulated skeleton on slab and counterslab.
biology: Only seven upper and six lower teeth per side; its describers considered it most likely an insect-eater, unlike the fish-eating pterosaurs it lived with in lakeside forests below active volcanoes.
author: Lü and Bo 2011

species.name: Jianchangopterus zhaoianus
species.author: Lü and Bo 2011
